reason: A DSH integration that inspects cold session placement and lets users move cold JSONL sessions between workspaces through the Web sidebar when the required patched runtime is installed.

summaries.zh: 通过 DSH Web 侧边栏在工作区之间移动冷 JSONL 会话，并提供只读检查与恢复验证。
summaries.en: Move cold JSONL sessions between DSH workspaces through the DSH Web sidebar with read-only inspection and recovery validation.

capabilities: Read-only inspection of cold DSH session workspace metadata and JSONL persistence
User-initiated relocation of cold JSONL sessions between DSH workspaces when the required patched runtime is available
Preservation and validation of session identifiers, event history, headers, and workspace ownership during relocation
Crash recovery through a durable local move journal
